page_title: ALM 1-2 PAL | Almeria v Las Palmas 28/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Francisco Maeso has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' 1 - 2 Goal! Sory Kaba (Las Palmas) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
86' The referee signals a substitution. Marciano Sanca (Almeria) is brought on as a substitute for Leo Baptistao.
82' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Marvin and he is replaced by Julian Araujo (Las Palmas).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) comes onto the pitch for Lucas Robertone.
77' Rough tackle by Leo Baptistao (Almeria). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.

73' 1 - 1 Largie Ramazani (Almeria) displayed brilliant individual skill before blasting in a shot from inside the box. His terrific effort went straight into the bottom left corner, via a ricochet off the post. Alvaro Valles had no chance. The score sheet now reads 1:1.
70' Almeria have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
69' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) replaces Maximo Perrone.
68' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Almeria.
63' The referee allows time for a substitution. Lazaro will be replaced by Largie Ramazani (Almeria).
60' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta decides to make a substitution. Marc Cardona will be replaced by Sory Kaba (Las Palmas).
60' Substitution. Munir El Haddadi is replaced by Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas).
59' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) makes a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
51' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Alvaro Valles makes a comfortable save.
49' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) sends a cross into the box, but Alvaro Valles comes off his line to gather the ball.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Alejandro Centelles Plaza is replaced by Sergio Arribas (Almeria).
46' Gaizka Garitano has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Houboulang Mendes (Almeria) comes on the pitch for Iddrisu Baba Mohammed.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Francisco Maeso has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
38' Flag goes up against Chumi (Almeria) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
36' Dion Lopy (Almeria) serves up a nice cross, but Alvaro Valles punches the ball away.
32' Cesar Montes (Almeria) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Francisco Maeso didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
31' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) has tested the patience of referee Francisco Maeso and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
30' The resulting set piece from Almeria is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
29' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Almeria, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' Las Palmas force a corner. They send men into the box.
28' Kirian (Las Palmas) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Fernando Martinez intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Las Palmas will have a chance to score from a corner.
27' Las Palmas quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

27' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee signals a corner kick to Las Palmas.

23' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) scores with a brilliant shot into the right side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Marvin. The score is 0:1.
22' Half-chance! Marvin (Las Palmas) plays a pass into the box, but Fernando Martinez reacts well to snuff out the attack.
18' The foul by Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Francisco Maeso.
17' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) is able to continue to play.
15' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
14' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
12' Kirian (Las Palmas) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Fernando Martinez, who smothers the ball.
8' What a wasted opportunity by Marc Cardona (Las Palmas)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Fernando Martinez makes a decent save to thwart him.
7' Marvin (Las Palmas) commits a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Marvin (Las Palmas) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Francisco Maeso blows for a foul.
4' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Las Palmas will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Francisco Maeso.
